explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/171, the density Hales–Jewett theorem (Furstenberg–Katznelson; Polymath). For every ε > 0 and t ≥ 1, for all large N, every A ⊆ [t]^N with |A| ≥ εt^N contains a combinatorial line, via Mathlib's Combinatorics.Line, which requires a non-constant coordinate. The degenerate t = 1 case holds trivially for N ≥ 1. Formal proof linked.
